access_policy.purpose: Candidate raw-only band analysis, pending main-run freeze.

analysis_brief.optional_scope_note: Cold-start characterization is limited to visible raw validation waveforms. Questions concern observable mixture properties only and do not attribute features to clean signal or noise; targets, predictions, residuals, and metadata are excluded.

questions.completion_criterion: Summarize the observed value ranges and distributions, quantization occupancy, repeated extrema, flat runs, abrupt discontinuities, and any non-finite or structurally invalid content across the accessible waveforms.
observations_to_verify: Whether values accumulate at integer extrema in a manner consistent with clipping or saturation.
Whether long constant runs, missing segments, or abrupt sample-to-sample jumps occur.
Whether amplitude distributions differ substantially among waveforms.
questions.question: What amplitude-range, quantization, and boundary behaviors characterize the raw integer waveforms?

questions.completion_criterion: Characterize broad spectral concentration, narrow peaks or harmonic families, and cross-waveform consistency using normalized frequency only, without assigning components to clean signal or noise.
observations_to_verify: Whether power is concentrated toward low, middle, or high normalized frequencies.
Whether narrow spectral peaks or harmonic patterns recur across waveforms.
Whether spectral shape varies enough across waveforms to indicate materially different raw regimes.
questions.question: How is raw waveform power distributed across normalized temporal frequencies, and which spectral structures are common or variable across waveforms?

questions.completion_criterion: Determine whether local amplitude, variance, spectral composition, and waveform morphology remain broadly stable or exhibit distinct changes over sample position.
observations_to_verify: Whether localized bursts, steps, transients, or variance changes occur.
Whether spectral composition changes materially over time within a waveform.
Whether nonstationary events are isolated or occupy substantial portions of records.
questions.question: To what extent are the raw waveforms temporally nonstationary within each record?

questions.completion_criterion: Summarize the persistence scales, oscillatory recurrences, and repeated motifs evident from raw-waveform temporal dependence, while avoiding claims about the latent clean waveform.
observations_to_verify: Whether short- or long-range sample dependence is prominent.
Whether stable oscillatory periods or repeated motifs appear within or across waveforms.
Whether temporal dependence differs substantially among accessible records.
questions.question: What recurring temporal dependence and periodic structure are directly observable in the raw mixtures?

available_assets.description: Raw validation input windows from the selected band.

forward_contract.embedding_note: Input values are integer-coded samples — nn.Embedding(256, embed_dim) to convert [B, T] int64 → [B, T, embed_dim], then transpose to [B, embed_dim, T] for Conv1d layers, remains a valid and common input stem. The input representation is unchanged; only the output is continuous.
forward_contract.output_description: continuous denoised waveform value per timestep
forward_contract.output_head_note: Output must be exactly [output_shape] — a continuous value per timestep, e.g. a final Conv1d(channels, 1, 1) followed by squeeze, or any head that emits [B, T] float32. Do NOT emit per-class logits and do NOT argmax: this task predicts waveform values directly. Residual formulations are natural here — predicting a correction to the input, or predicting the noise and subtracting it, preserves amplitude and low-frequency structure instead of regenerating the waveform from scratch.
forward_contract.task_note: Offline denoising — output at position t may depend on all positions. Causal constraints are not required. The objective is a continuous regression loss; robust choices such as SmoothL1/Huber are strong task-grounded starting points, and the loss itself remains searchable.

task_context.input_description: Integer-coded SQUID detector waveform samples at the task-declared physical cadence. The view contains one input channel and performs no interpolation, resampling, filtering, or repair.
scientific_constraints: Every certified selection must cover the selected files [0, 1, 2, 3] or refuse.
Findings concern sampled raw validation windows, not unseen data or hidden targets.
Use the declared physical cadence; distinguish measured findings from hypotheses.
task_context.scientific_goal: Characterize authorized raw waveform inputs in the selected band.
task_context.target_description: Clean injected waveform, not visible in the initial raw-data analysis.
task_context.task_description:
full-spectrum 1-D time-series denoising of SQUID dark-matter
detector data: map a noisy [B, T] integer signal to a clean
[B, T] continuous waveform, trained across the whole frequency
spectrum within the selected band at once (not split into per-file or
per-frequency models). This is a
continuous regression task — the model predicts waveform values
directly, not a distribution over discrete levels.
